hypothesis: Replace the failed 4-leg SPY iron condor with a simpler 2-leg SPY bull put credit spread. Dual-side ICs produced inventory orphans, lot mismatches, and negative expectancy (PF 0.70). A single put credit keeps defined risk, rides long-term equity drift, halves leg complexity, and makes stop/target accounting auditable. Paper-only 1-lot validation tests whether this structure can produce expectancy > 0 and PF > 1 over 30 clean trades.
changed_rules: KILL ic_simple / iron_condor as North Star entry path (data/runtime/strategy_kill_switch.json). No new IC entries.
Active family is spy_put_credit only: sell 1 SPY put + buy 1 lower put (bull put credit), never naked, never multi-leg 4-leg IC.
Paper-only validation; live and scale remain blocked until kill criteria clear.
1 contract only, max 3 new structures per day, max 2 concurrent put credits, SPY only.
30-45 DTE, target short delta 0.15 (band 0.10-0.22), wing width $5 only (reject 10-wide).
Live-delta strike provenance required; reject heuristic fallback and net credit < $0.50.
Exit: take profit at 25% of max profit; stop at 200% of credit; min hold 24h; force manage/exit by 7 DTE.
No same-expiry re-entry after a loss; no sub-24h discretionary closes except hard stop.
Block new entries if open inventory is unclean (lot/orphan/journal mismatch) or broker sync is stale.
Record exit_reason on every close (profit_target, stop_loss, dte_exit, orphan_cleanup).

prohibited_rule_repeats: Do not reopen 10-wide SPY iron condors.
Do not use multi-contract sizing before the put-credit cohort clears kill criteria.
Do not hold credit structures past 7 DTE without managed exit.
Do not use unmanaged sub-24-hour exits as discretionary management.
Do not reintroduce 4-leg IC entry while strategy_kill_switch lists ic_simple/iron_condor as killed.

post_clearance_scaling_plan.trigger: All kill_criteria met (n>=30, expectancy>0, PF>1.05, total P/L>0)

phase_1_scale_to_live.description: Transition from paper validation to live capital with conservative sizing
phase_1_scale_to_live.success_criteria: No weekly drawdown > 5% of equity, PF > 1.10, expectancy > $10/trade

phase_2_scale_to_north_star.description: Scale to reach $6,000/month North Star target
phase_2_scale_to_north_star.note: At 1-lot ($55 avg credit), need 109 trades/month = 5.5 trades/day to reach $6,000/month. With 6 contracts, need ~18 trades/month = 0.9 trades/day. Current max_daily_structures=3 supports 60 trades/month at 6 contracts = ~$3,300/month. To fully reach $6,000/month, either increase max_daily_structures to 6 or increase contracts to 10.
phase_2_scale_to_north_star.success_criteria: Monthly P/L >= $6,000 after tax for 3 consecutive months

stop_loss_refinement.description: Tighten stop loss based on backtest evidence
stop_loss_refinement.rationale: Bull put spread backtest (2025-10-16 to 2025-11-29) showed avg win $25.85 vs avg loss $148.08 with 200% stop. Tightening to 100% would reduce avg loss to ~$74, improving profit factor from 0.48 to ~0.96. Further refinement to 75% stop would bring PF above 1.0.

guardrails: Never exceed 5% of equity at risk across all concurrent positions
Never reintroduce 10-wide wings or 4-leg IC structures
Weekly drawdown gate: block new entries if weekly P/L < -3% of equity
Monthly PF gate: block scaling if monthly PF < 1.0 for 2 consecutive months
Broker sync must be verified before every entry (no blind trading)

approval_record.scope: scrap IC Simple; paper validation of spy_put_credit only; live remains blocked
approval_record.directive: do not be afraid to scrap previous strategy for a better winning system
